# 0003. Types are generated by an explicit export list

- Status: accepted
- Date: 2026-10-02

## Context and problem

ts-rs normally exports types annotated `#[ts(export)]` as a side effect of `cargo test`, into
a directory set by an environment variable. That makes generation depend on which tests run.

## Decision

`contracts::typegen::export_types(dir)` exports a fixed list of root types (and everything they
reference). `npm run gen:types` writes `src/generated/` from it. The test
`generated_types_are_current` exports into a temporary folder and fails if `src/generated/`
differs in any file.

## Consequences

Adding a type to the API means adding it to the list; forgetting shows up as a missing import
in TypeScript.
